title: Questions 149-150 refer to the following notice.
passage_1:
TEMPORARY POWER INTERRUPTION

Please be advised that the district electric authority will be conducting required upgrades on the feeder that delivers power to our building this coming Tuesday, February 6. Consequently, electricity to all suites will be cut off between 9:00 A.M. and 3:00 P.M.

We advise that you charge sufficient batteries in laptops or power banks for calls and typing prior to the shutdown hour. Once the power returns, the lights may flicker slightly. This is expected; simply leave the switch on for a few minutes until it steadies.
